description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

name: TM - Giga Drain
description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM - Iron Tail
description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: TM - Shock Wave
description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

name: TM - Secret Power
description: The user attacks the target with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user's environment.

name: TM - Steel Wing
description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

name: TM - Skill Swap
description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

name: TM - Snatch
description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the opponent attempts to use.

name: TM - Roost
description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

name: TM - Brine
description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

name: TM - Endure
description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TM - Dragon Pulse
description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

name: TM - Drain Punch
description: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM - Silver Wind
description: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.

name: TM - Recycle
description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

name: TM - Avalanche
description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

name: TM - Stealth Rock
description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opponent's team. The trap hurts opponents that switch into battle.

name: TM - Captivate
description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM - Dark Pulse
description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM - Sleep Talk
description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

name: TM - Natural Gift
description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

name: TM - Leech Life
description: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM - Nature Power
description: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

name: TM - Air Slash
description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM - Bug Buzz
description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Power Gem
description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

name: TM - Razor Wind
description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Brave Bird
description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

name: TM - Whirlwind
description: The target is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: TM - Nasty Plot
description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

name: TM - Thunder Fang
description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

name: TM - Ice Fang
description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

name: TM - Fire Fang
description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.

name: TM - Psycho Cut
description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Horn Drill
description: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

name: TM - Take Down
description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. It also damages the user a little.

name: TM - Leaf Storm
description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM - Power Whip
description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.

name: TM - Pin Missile
description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

name: TM - Cross Poison
description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also leave the target poisoned. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Water Gun
description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

name: TM - Hydro Pump
description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

name: TM - BubbleBeam
description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the opposing team. It may also lower their Speed stats.

name: TM - Submission
description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

name: TM - Mega Drain
description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM - Dragon Rage
description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

name: TM - Fire Spin
description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

name: TM - Heavy Slam
description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

name: TM - Electro Ball
description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Fissure
description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

name: TM - Agility
description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

name: TM - Rage
description: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

name: TM - Teleport
description: When used by a Trainer, it switches the user out no matter what. Wild Pokémon may flee instantly. When used out of battle, it will warp you to the last Pokémon Center.

name: TM - Stored Power
description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Hex
description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

name: TM - Focus Energy
description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Bide
description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

name: TM - Egg Bomb
description: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

name: TM - Skull Bash
description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

name: TM - Amnesia
description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Razor Shell
description: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: TM - Heat Crash
description: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Tail Slap
description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

name: TM - Hurricane
description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

name: TM - Psywave
description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

name: TM - Tri Attack
description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Curse
description: A move which functions differently depending on the type of its user. When used by a Ghost, the target loses 1/4 of their maximum HP every turn, but the user immediately loses half of theirs. For other types, it will reduce Speed while increasing Attack & Defense by 1 stage.

name: TM - Reversal
description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

name: TM - Scary Face
description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

name: TM - Spikes
description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team's feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: TM - Zap Cannon
description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

name: TM - Detect
description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TM - Charm
description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

name: TM - Megahorn
description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

name: TM - DragonBreath
description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Baton Pass
description: The user switches places with a Pokémon in your party, passing along some effects. Will not pass stat changes or status ailments.

name: TM - Encore
description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

name: TM - Sweet Scent
description: Expels a sweet scent which lowers the foe's Evasion. It lures hordes of Pokémon when used in areas which have wild encounters, but requires more PP.

name: TM - Crunch
description: Crunches the foe with its sharp teeth. It may lower their Defense stat.

name: TM - Future Sight
description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

name: TM - Whirlpool
description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

name: TM - Beat Up
description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

name: TM - Revenge
description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

name: TM - Imprison
description: If the opponents know any move also known by the user, the opponents are prevented from using it.

name: TM - Screech
description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

name: TM - Blaze Kick
description: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM - Weather Ball
description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

name: TM - Fake Tears
description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Cosmic Power
description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: TM - Sand Tomb
description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

name: TM - Muddy Water
description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' accuracy.

name: TM - Icicle Spear
description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

name: TM - Mud Shot
description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target's Speed.

name: TM - Magical Leaf
description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.

name: TM - Leaf Blade
description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Dragon Dance
description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

name: TM - Rock Blast
description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

name: TM - Close Combat
description: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

name: TM - Assurance
description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

name: TM - Power Swap
description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

name: TM - Guard Swap
description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

name: TM - Pay Day
description: Throws coins at the foe which are recovered after the battle. The amount of coins increases with the foe's level. It's only effective once per battle.

name: TM - Toxic Spikes
description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opponent's feet. They poison opponents that switch into battle.

name: TM - Flare Blitz
description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. The user sustains serious damage and may leave the target burned.

name: TM - Aura Sphere
description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This move is certain to hit.

name: TM - Counter
description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

name: TM - Metronome
description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

name: TM - Mega Kick
description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

name: TM - Mega Punch
description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

name: TM - Double-Edge
description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

name: TM - Body Slam
description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Softboiled
description: Heals the user by half of its max HP.

name: TM - Rollout
description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

name: TM - DynamicPunch
description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

name: TM - Mimic
description: The user copies the target's last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

name: TM - Fury Cutter
description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

name: TM - Seismic Toss
description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

name: TM - Mud-Slap
description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

name: TM - Psybeam
description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

name: TM - Confuse Ray
description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

name: TM - Poison Tail
description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Metal Claw
description: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

name: TM - Swift
description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

name: TM - Icy Wind
description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also reduces the targets' Speed stat.

name: TM - Air Cutter
description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Night Shade
description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user's level.

name: TM - Foul Play
description: The user turns the target's power against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Seed Bomb
description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

name: TM - Iron Head
description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM - Gunk Shot
description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

name: TM - Iron Defense
description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

name: TM - Drill Run
description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Trick
description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

name: TM - Tailwind
description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

name: TM - Hyper Voice
description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

name: TM - Heat Wave
description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.

name: TM - Earth Power
description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

name: TM - Outrage
description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

name: TM - Draco Meteor
description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM - Fire Punch
description: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM - Ice Punch
description: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.

name: TM - ThunderPunch
description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Zen Headbutt
description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM - Helping Hand
description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

name: TM - Low Kick
description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier targets.

name: TM - Acid Spray
description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Headbutt
description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM - Selfdestruct
description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

name: TM - Superpower
description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

name: TM - Charge
description: The user charges up, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move. It also raises the Sp. Def of the user by 1 stage.

name: TM - Haze
description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

name: TM - Spite
description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

name: TM - Gravity
description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitate.

name: TM - Knock Off
description: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

name: TM - Bug Bite
description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

name: TM - Super Fang
description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

name: TM - Vacuum Wave
description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

name: TM - Uproar
description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

name: Master Ball
description: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

name: Ultra Ball
description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

name: Great Ball
description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

name: Poké Ball
description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

name: Safari Ball
description: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

name: Net Ball
description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

name: Dive Ball
description: A somewhat different Poké Ball which works especially well on Pokémon that are encountered in water.

name: Nest Ball
description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

name: Repeat Ball
description: A Poké Ball which grows in strength every consecutive capture of a species of Pokémon. It powers up even when using a different type of Poké Ball. Its power is reset to 1.0x if you capture something else, or if you don't capture anything for a few days.

name: Timer Ball
description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

name: Luxury Ball
description: A luxurious Poké Ball which helps grow your friendship with a Pokémon quickly. It works well on Pokémon which evolve due to happiness.

name: Premier Ball
description: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

name: Dusk Ball
description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

name: Heal Ball
description: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon's HP and eliminates any status problem.

name: Quick Ball
description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if it is used at the start of a wild encounter.

name: Cherish Ball
description: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.

name: Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

name: Antidote
description: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

name: Burn Heal
description: A spray-type medicine. It heals a single Pokémon that is suffering from a burn.

name: Ice Heal
description: A spray-type medicine. It defrosts a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.

name: Awakening
description: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

name: Parlyz Heal
description: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.

name: Full Restore
description: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Max Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Hyper Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 120 points.

name: Super Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

name: Full Heal
description: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Revive
description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon's maximum HP.

name: Max Revive
description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It fully restores the Pokémon's HP.

name: Fresh Water
description: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 30 points.

name: Soda Pop
description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

name: Lemonade
description: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 70 points.

name: Moomoo Milk
description: Milk with a very high nutrition content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 100 points.

name: EnergyPowder
description: A very bitter medicine powder. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

name: Energy Root
description: A very bitter root. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

name: Heal Powder
description: A very bitter medicine powder. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Revival Herb
description: A very bitter herb.  It revives a Pokémon to half its max HP if they were fainted.

name: Ether
description: It restores the PP of a Pokémon's selected move by a maximum of 15 points.

name: Max Ether
description: It fully restores the PP of a single selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Elixir
description: It restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon by 10 points each.

name: Max Elixir
description: It fully restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon.

name: Lava Cookie
description: Lavaridge Town's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

name: Berry Juice
description: A 20% pure juice made of Berries. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

name: Sacred Ash
description: A bag of sparkling ash gathered after defeating Radiant Ho-Oh. When used, it revives any fainted Pokémon and restores all Pokémon in your party to full HP.  This item is consumed upon use. If used during a battle in which you white out, it will reappear after.

name: HP Up
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Protein
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Iron
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Carbos
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Calcium
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Atk (Special Attack) stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Rare Candy
description: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

name: PP Up
description: It slightly raises the maximum PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Zinc
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def (Special Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

name: PP Max
description: It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Old Gateau
description: Old Chateau's hidden specialty. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Guard Spec.
description: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer's party Pokémon for five turns after use.

name: Dire Hit
description: It raises the critical-hit ratio greatly. It can be used only once and wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Attack
description: An item which raises the Attack of a Pokémon in battle by 2 stages. It wears off if they're withdrawn.  Only 2 can be used at a time. Consumed upon use.

name: X Defend
description: An item which raises the Defense of a Pokémon in battle by 2 stages. It wears off if they're withdrawn.  Only 2 can be used at a time. Consumed upon use.

name: X Speed
description: An item which raises the Speed of a Pokémon in battle by 2 stages. It wears off if they're withdrawn.  Only 2 can be used at a time. Consumed upon use.

name: X Accuracy
description: An item which raises the Accuracy of a Pokémon in battle by 2 stages. It wears off if they're withdrawn.  Only 2 can be used at a time. Consumed upon use.

name: X Special
description: An item which raises the Sp. Attack of a Pokémon in battle by 2 stages. It wears off if they're withdrawn.  Only 2 can be used at a time. Consumed upon use.

name: Iron Plate
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

name: Odd Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Psychic-type moves by 20%.  If held by a Mr. Mime while breeding, it may help them produce a Mime Jr. egg.

name: Rock Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Rock-type moves by 20%.  If held by a Sudowoodo while breeding, it may help them produce a Bonsly egg.

name: Full Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. it causes the Pokémon to move last when using a move of the same priority as the opponent.  If held by a Snorlax while breeding, it may help them produce a Munchlax egg.

name: Wave Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Water-type moves by 20%.  If held by a Mantine while breeding, it may help them produce a Mantyke egg.

name: Rose Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Grass-type moves by 20%.  If held by a Roselia or Roserade while breeding, it may help them produce a Budew egg.

name: Luck Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If held by a Chansey while breeding, it may help them produce a Happiny egg.

name: Pure Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly reduces the chance of encountering wild Pokémon.  If held by a Chimecho while breeding, it may help them produce a Chingling egg.

name: Protector
description: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Electirizer
description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Magmarizer
description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Dubious Disc
description: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

name: Reaper Cloth
description: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Razor Claw
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.

name: Razor Fang
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may make foes and allies flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

name: TM - Hone Claws
description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

name: TM - Dragon Claw
description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

name: TM - Psyshock
description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: TM - Calm Mind
description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

name: TM - Roar
description: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: TM - Toxic
description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

name: TM - Snowscape
description: A snowstorm forms on the field for 5 turns. Snow boosts the Defense stat of Ice-types by 50%.

name: TM - Bulk Up
description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

name: TM - Venoshock
description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

name: TM - Hidden Power
description: An attack which varies in type depending on its user. Its type may be changed with 40 Gems.

name: TM - Sunny Day
description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

name: TM - Taunt
description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

name: TM - Ice Beam
description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

name: TM - Blizzard
description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

name: TM - Hyper Beam
description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

name: TM - Light Screen
description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

name: TM - Protect
description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TM - Rain Dance
description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

name: TM - Telekinesis
description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

name: TM - Safeguard
description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

name: TM - Frustration
description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

name: TM - SolarBeam
description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

name: TM - Smack Down
description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

name: TM - Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Thunder
description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TM - Earthquake
description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes those around it.

name: TM - Return
description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

name: TM - Dig
description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

name: TM - Psychic
description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Shadow Ball
description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Brick Break
description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

name: TM - Double Team
description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

name: TM - Reflect
description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

name: TM - Sludge Wave
description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

name: TM - Flamethrower
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM - Sludge Bomb
description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

name: TM - Sandstorm
description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

name: TM - Fire Blast
description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM - Rock Tomb
description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

name: TM - Aerial Ace
description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

name: TM - Torment
description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

name: TM - Facade
description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

name: TM - Flame Charge
description: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat.

name: TM - Rest
description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

name: TM - Attract
description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

name: TM - Thief
description: An attack which steals the foe's held item if the user isn't already holding one. Its effects are temporary when stealing from Trainers.

name: TM - Low Sweep
description: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.

name: TM - Round
description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

name: TM - Echoed Voice
description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

name: TM - Overheat
description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM - Ally Switch
description: The user teleports, switching places with its adjacent ally. It may fail if used consecutively.

name: TM - Focus Blast
description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

name: TM - Energy Ball
description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

name: TM - False Swipe
description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

name: TM - Scald
description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM - Fling
description: The user flings its item at the foe, destroying it. In PvP, only consumable items are destroyed permanently. The move's power and effects vary depending on what item is thrown.

name: TM - Charge Beam
description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM - Sky Drop
description: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

name: TM - Incinerate
description: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

name: TM - Quash
description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

name: TM - Will-O-Wisp
description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

name: TM - Acrobatics
description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

name: TM - Embargo
description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

name: TM - Explosion
description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

name: TM - Shadow Claw
description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM - Payback
description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

name: TM - Retaliate
description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack's damage increases.

name: TM - Giga Impact
description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: TM - Rock Polish
description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

name: TM - Flash
description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

name: TM - Stone Edge
description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM - Volt Switch
description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM - Thunder Wave
description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

name: TM - Gyro Ball
description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Swords Dance
description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

name: TM - Struggle Bug
description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

name: TM - Psych Up
description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

name: TM - Bulldoze
description: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon's Speed stat is reduced.

name: TM - Frost Breath
description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

name: TM - Rock Slide
description: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

name: TM - X-Scissor
description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: TM - Dragon Tail
description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: TM - Work Up
description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

name: TM - Poison Jab
description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.

name: TM - Dream Eater
description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

name: TM - Grass Knot
description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

name: TM - Swagger
description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

name: TM - Pluck
description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

name: TM - U-turn
description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM - Substitute
description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

name: TM - Flash Cannon
description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM - Trick Room
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: HM - Cut
description: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

name: HM - Fly
description: The user soars, then strikes its target on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

name: HM - Surf
description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

name: HM - Strength
description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

name: HM - Waterfall
description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

name: HM - Dive
description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second turn. It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

name: Explorer Kit
description: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.

name: Loot Sack
description: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

name: Rule Book
description: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

name: Poké Radar
description: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

name: Point Card
description: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

name: Journal
description: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

name: Seal Case
description: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.

name: Fashion Case
description: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

name: Seal Bag
description: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

name: Pal Pad
description: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

name: Works Key
description: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

name: Old Charm
description: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

name: Galactic Key
description: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

name: Red Chain
description: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

name: Town Map
description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

name: Vs. Seeker
description: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

name: Coin Case
description: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

name: Old Rod
description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Good Rod
description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Super Rod
description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Sprayduck
description: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

name: Poffin Case
description: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

name: Bicycle
description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

name: Suite Key
description: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

name: Oak's Letter
description: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

name: Lunar Wing
description: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

name: Member Card
description: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

name: Azure Flute
description: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

name: S.S. Ticket
description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

name: Contest Pass
description: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

name: Magma Stone
description: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.

name: Parcel
description: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

name: Coupon 1
description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 2
description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 3
description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

name: Storage Key
description: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

name: SecretPotion
description: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

name: Vs. Recorder
description: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

name: Gracidea
description: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

name: Secret Key
description: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.

name: Apricorn Box
description: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.

name: Unown Report
description: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.

name: Berry Pots
description: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

name: Dowsing MCHN
description: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.

name: Blue Card
description: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.

name: SlowpokeTail
description: A very tasty tail of something. It sells for a high price.

name: Clear Bell
description: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.

name: Card Key
description: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

name: Basement Key
description: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

name: SquirtBottle
description: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

name: Red Scale
description: A scale from the red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.

name: Lost Item
description: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.

name: Pass
description: A ticket required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.

name: Machine Part
description: An important machine part for the Power Plant that was stolen.

name: Silver Wing
description: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

name: Rainbow Wing
description: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.

name: Mystery Egg
description: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What's in the Egg is unknown.

name: Red Apricorn
description: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

name: Blu Apricorn
description: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

name: Ylw Apricorn
description: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

name: Grn Apricorn
description: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

name: Pnk Apricorn
description: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

name: Wht Apricorn
description: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.

name: Blk Apricorn
description: A black Apricorn It has an indescribable scent.

name: Fast Ball
description: A Poké Ball which is excellent at capturing Pokémon with high base Speed.

name: Level Ball
description: A Poké Ball which is excellent at capturing Pokémon who are the same level as yours.

name: Lure Ball
description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.

name: Heavy Ball
description: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.

name: Love Ball
description: A Poké Ball which is excellent at capturing Pokémon of the same evolution line as yours, but of the opposite gender. It doesn't help against genderless foes.

name: Friend Ball
description: A Poké Ball which makes a Pokémon very happy upon capture. It works well on Pokémon which evolve due to happiness.

name: Moon Ball
description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.

name: Sport Ball
description: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.

name: Park Ball
description: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.

name: Photo Album
description: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.

name: GB Sounds
description: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with a single switch.

name: Tidal Bell
description: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.

name: RageCandyBar
description: A famous Mahogany Town candy tourists like to buy and take home. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

name: Data Card 01
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many victories you've had.

name: Data Card 02
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many losses you've had.

name: Data Card 03
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have dashed.

name: Data Card 04
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have jumped.

name: Data Card 05
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Hurdle Dash.

name: Data Card 06
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Relay Run.

name: Data Card 07
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Pennant Capture.

name: Data Card 08
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Block Smash.

name: Data Card 09
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Disc Catch.

name: Data Card 10
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Snow Throw.

name: Data Card 11
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many points your Pokémon scored.

name: Data Card 12
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have failed.

name: Data Card 13
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon impeded themselves.

name: Data Card 14
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have tackled.

name: Data Card 15
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have fallen down.

name: Data Card 16
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Ring Drop.

name: Data Card 17
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Lamp Jump.

name: Data Card 18
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Circle Push.

name: Data Card 19
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon wins you've had.

name: Data Card 20
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon losses you've had.

name: Data Card 21
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won an event.

name: Data Card 22
description: An item to be held by Salamence which raises its Sp.Attack.

name: Data Card 23
description: An item to be held by Salamence which raises its Sp.Defense.

name: Data Card 24
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Goal Roll.

name: Data Card 25
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon won individual prizes.

name: Data Card 26
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've instructed your Pokémon.

name: Data Card 27
description: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how much time you've spent in the Pokéathlon.

name: Jade Orb
description: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

name: Lock Capsule
description: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.

name: Red Orb
description: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

name: Blue Orb
description: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

name: Enigma Stone
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will heal for 25% HP if they are hit by a super effective move.

name: Prism Scale
description: A mysterious scale that evolves certain Pokémon. It shines in rainbow colors.

name: Eviolite
description: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held, it raises the Defense and Sp. Def of a Pokémon that can still evolve.

name: Float Stone
description: A very light stone. It reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.

name: Rocky Helmet
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder of this item is hit by a move that makes contact, it will inflict damage on the attacker for 16.67% of their maximum HP per-hit.

name: Air Balloon
description: When held by a Pokémon, the Pokémon will float into the air. When the holder is attacked, this item will burst.

name: Red Card
description: A card with a mysterious power. When the holder is struck by a foe, the attacker is removed from battle.

name: Ring Target
description: Moves that would otherwise have no effect will land on the Pokémon that holds it.

name: Binding Band
description: When held by a Pokémon, it causes the damage inflicted by binding moves used by the holder to increase from 12.5% to 16.7% of the opponent's maximum HP at the end of each turn.

name: Absorb Bulb
description: A consumable bulb. If the holder is hit by a Water-type move, its Sp. Atk will rise.

name: Cell Battery
description: A consumable battery. If the holder is hit by an Electric-type move, its Attack will rise.

name: Eject Button
description: If the holder is hit by an attack, it will switch with another Pokémon in your party.

name: Fire Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Fire-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Water Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Water-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Electric Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Electric-ty pe moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Grass Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Grass-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Ice Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Ice-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Fighting Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Fighting-ty pe moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Poison Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Poison-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Ground Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Ground-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Flying Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Flying-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Psychic Gem
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It increases the power of Psychic-type moves by 50%.  This item is consumed upon use.

name: Bug Gem
